editor.kinds.decision_about: a fork: the leader picks a branch
editor.kinds.arrow_about: a transition from element to element
editor.kinds.group_about: a frame that holds elements and areas
editor.kinds.area_about: a strip or zone that holds elements, like a group
editor.kinds.table_about: rows and columns: a matrix, a list of features
editor.kinds.link_about: a reference to a related object, including one in another folder
editor.canvasopts.snap_hint: A block moves smoothly and, when you let go, settles exactly on the points
editor.canvasopts.grid_hint: The points scale together with the canvas
editor.canvasopts.gridStep_hint: Distance between points in scheme units
editor.canvasopts.gridInk_hint: Left — the points are almost transparent, right — clearly visible. At a small scale they fade on their own
editor.canvasopts.trackpadPan_title: Move the canvas with two fingers on the trackpad
editor.canvasopts.trackpadPan_hint: If you turn it off, a two-finger scroll changes the zoom and the canvas moves with the space bar
editor.canvasopts.pinchZoom_title: Pinch with two fingers to zoom
editor.canvasopts.pinchZoom_hint: Ctrl and the mouse wheel do the same
editor.canvasopts.zoomSpeed_hint: Left — softer and slower, right — faster
editor.canvasopts.spacePan_title: Hold space — the canvas follows the mouse
editor.canvasopts.spacePan_hint: No need to press the mouse button: just move
editor.canvasopts.assetsView_hint: How to show attached files and specs
editor.canvasopts.arrowPorts_hint: Manual — the arrow remembers the port it was dragged from and dropped on
editor.canvasopts.agentsView_hint: A list is quicker to read, tiles are more visual
editor.canvasopts.runShow_hint: Each new status of a block and an arrow stays on screen and blinks so the change is visible. If you turn it off, the canvas shows what is on the server right now
editor.canvasopts.runShowSec_title: Run: how long to keep a status, s
editor.canvasopts.runShowSec_hint: Works when the display delay is on. It does not slow the run itself — only what you see
editor.canvasopts.runFollow_hint: The canvas glides to the block that has just opened. Same as the “Follow” button next to the run badge
editor.canvasopts.opt_manual: where I dropped it by hand
editor.variants.canvas_about: draw a scheme with the mouse
editor.variants.list_about: long schemes: a table of blocks, editing from the keyboard
editor.variants.hierarchy_about: what lies in what: levels as columns, like in a file browser
editor.variants.run_about: watch how the work goes: steps, results, time
